optimized_decoder_capacity_evidence.adaptation_evidence: The first 3584-token attempt failed an explicit QKV program config at 33,018,624 bytes of static circular buffers versus 1,572,864 bytes L1, not DRAM capacity. Restricting the measured large-prefill configs to at most 576 flattened tokens and using TTNN's general large-M config above that envelope made 3584 and 4096 pass. The public sequence length remains unrestricted; MLP internals chunk only above 576 flattened tokens.
optimized_decoder_capacity_evidence.claim: 4096 is a tested supported optimized-decoder length, not a measured hardware maximum. The earlier functional 3583/3584 boundary remains valid only for the BF16 functional implementation.

multichip_decoder_plan.calculation_policy: Tile-aware physical DRAM storage: BFP4_B=576 bytes per 32x32 tile, BFP8_B=1088 bytes per tile, BF16=2048 bytes per tile. The fixed DRAM lifetime includes both optimized decode and interleaved large-M prefill matrix representations for all 40 layers, tiled replicated layer/final norms, TP4 BF16 embedding and untied LM head, persistent split-trace token/logit state, Sampling1D index/seed buffers, and the Metal trace region used by the full 40-layer split model/sampler capture. The configured 200,000,000-byte trace region is reserved independently in each of eight DRAM banks, so its physical per-device cost is 1,600,000,000 bytes. RoPE prefill+decode tables, shared position indices, page table, and all 40 local K/V pairs scale with logical context. The selected decoder keeps one 1,310,720-byte BF16 L1 collective workspace shared by all sequential layers and emits decode collective results in BF16; neither is a persistent DRAM lifetime and neither reduces the DRAM-derived context ceiling. The capacity gate additionally allocates a physical 1.5 GiB per-rank runtime reserve, executes a batch-32 prefill chunk with all full-context caches resident, then decodes position 32,767. The post-reserve physical ceiling is 34,464 after rounding down to the 32-token page block.
multichip_decoder_plan.prefill_policy: The 32K cache and weights fit, but a replicated batch-32 full-width 32K BF16 residual is 10,737,418,240 bytes per rank. Full-context prefill must therefore stream/chunk internal work while preserving arbitrary logical lengths.

multichip_decoder_plan.claim: The recalculated full-model decode and retained prefill weights, all 40 BFP8 paged-cache pairs, BF16 TP endpoints, Sampling1D state, split-trace terminal buffers, 200,000,000 bytes of trace reservation per DRAM bank (1,600,000,000 bytes/device), and 1.5 GiB runtime reserve fit at the HF 32768-token limit with 1,189,509,248 bytes/rank remaining. notes: The functional BF16 evidence and its exact 3583-token boundary are retained for provenance, as is the single-chip optimized decoder's tested 4096-token result. The full model preserves the TP4 decoder and HF 32768-token contract: both optimized decode and large-M prefill matrix representations for all 40 layers, all 40 local BFP8 K/V pairs, BF16 TP vocabulary endpoints, shared RoPE/indices, fixed-slot page table, device positions, common Sampling1D state, split-trace terminal buffers, the 200,000,000-byte-per-bank (1,600,000,000-byte/device) full-stack trace reservation, and a physically allocated 1.5 GiB runtime reserve fit per rank. Full-context batch-32 prompt ingestion streams: the optimized prefill window handles the prefix and device decode fills the remaining cache positions, because a fully materialized replicated batch-32 32K BF16 residual is 10,737,418,240 bytes per rank. The physical capacity proof retains prefill weights and executes a prefill chunk before decode; the optional one-way release_prefill_weights_for_decode compatibility transition is not required for the advertised context.
